Steel products are used in automobile bodies, building frameworks, ships, pipes for oil and natural gas drilling, and railway vehicle parts. The company also operates engineering businesses that design and construct plants and social infrastructure, IT services, and chemical and electronic materials businesses. The 'Business Profit,' which the company cites as a representative indicator of profit, is calculated as revenue less cost of sales, selling, general and administrative expenses and other expenses, plus equity-method investment income and other income, and the company explains that it represents the results of sustainable business activities.
